title: Switch App.tsx to react-router-dom HashRouter with exact / and /wishes routes

requirements.summary: Replace TanStack Router in App.tsx with react-router-dom HashRouter and define only / and /wishes routes.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/App.tsx` uses `HashRouter`, `Routes`, and `Route` from `react-router-dom` (no TanStack Router usage remains in App.tsx).
Visiting `/#/` renders the `Home` page UI (hero, hearts rain, gift box, footer).
Visiting `/#/wishes` renders the `AdminWishes` page UI and does NOT render any `Home`-only content (including the GiftBox and any fireworks triggered from it).

file_operations.description: Remove TanStack Router usage and implement react-router-dom hash routing by importing HashRouter, Routes, and Route; wrap the app in <HashRouter>; and define exactly these routes: path "/" -> <Home /> and path "/wishes" -> <AdminWishes /> (no other routes or fallback rendering).

requirements.summary: Ensure direct navigation/refresh to #/wishes renders only AdminWishes without Home fallback or flash.
acceptanceCriteria: On a hard refresh while the browser URL hash is `#/wishes`, the first rendered page is `AdminWishes` (no flash of `Home` content that remains on screen).
There is no route configuration that renders `Home` outside of the `path="/"` route.

file_operations.description: Double-check the HashRouter + Routes configuration does not render Home outside the "/" route (no layout/shared wrapper that includes Home content; no wildcard route that points to Home; ensure /wishes maps only to AdminWishes).

Add a lightweight routing regression test that mounts <App /> with the window location hash set to "#/wishes" and asserts AdminWishes content is present while Home-only content (e.g., GiftBox/hero text) is absent, preventing future fallback/flash regressions.
